tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Battery bank for UPS System of Stacker cum re-claimer.
tenderSchedule.description: a. Supply, Erection and Commissioning of 1 Nos. battery bank (58 Nos. Batteries) of 2V, 64 Ah Exide, Model YAP 17 (Plante) Battery for UPS System of Stacker cum reclaimer. b.Dismantling and transportation of released batteries (Make Exide, Model No. YAP 17 (Plante)) along with accessories to bidders location. c. Carrying out initial charging/discharging of batteries and service personnel should be available till the batteries are taken in line with the system. d.To make necessary load arrangements for carrying out discharge test of batteries. e.Providing suitable stand for mounting batteries, cables, accessories and other consumables like bolts, nuts, connectors (consumables 10 percent extra should be supplied) etc. f.Tools & Tackles required for completion of work.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer I1 Office YTPS Raichur

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The intending bidder shall meet the Pre-Qualification Requirements (PQR) and submit the relevant documentary evidence in support thereof. Fulfilment of these requirements is a mandatory pre-requisite for opening of Part-II (Price Bid).

The bidder shall be an authorized dealer of Exide batteries or shall possess a valid Manufacturers Authorization Letter issued by Exide, specifically authorizing the bidder to participate in the subject tender for Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Battery bank for UPS System of Stacker cum reclaimer. The bidder shall submit a copy of the valid Manufacturers Authorization Certificate/Authorization Letter as documentary evidence along with the bid.

technicalCriterionList.description: List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder shall have successfully executed works involving Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Battery Banks of similar rating (2V, 64 AH, Model: YAP17) or higher rating in Thermal Power Plants of 210 MW capacity and above, or in Government Organizations / Public Sector Undertakings such as BHEL, NTPC or State GENCOs, with a cumulative executed order value of not less than 4.90 Lakhs. As documentary evidence, the bidder shall submit copies of relevant Work Orders / Job Orders / Purchase Orders (POs). The stipulated cumulative order value may be established through a single work order executed during any two of the preceding five years reckoned from the date of notification of the tender.

The bidder shall have achieved an average annual turnover of not less than 9.80 Lakhs in any two financial years out of the preceding five financial years reckoned from the date of notification of the tender. As documentary evidence, the bidder shall submit copies of the relevant Profit and Loss Statements along with a Turnover Certificate duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA).
